name: multi-select
title: Multi select
description: Type to filter a list and pick several options, shown as removable tags.
a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox with a listbox that has aria-multiselectable; options carry aria-selected.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move, Enter toggles the active option, Escape closes, Tab leaves.
Backspace in an empty field removes the last tag; each tag has a button named "Remove <label>".
